reason: This plugin is primarily a user-interface session navigation enhancement for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: it introduces Chat/Work mode navigation and manages a managed Chat workspace that appears in the sidebar. Evidence shows it registers mode segments, derives mode from where a conversation is stored, and keeps the Chat workspace group first via host/browser-side workspace ordering, rather than changing agent tooling or external integrations directly. Overall, its user-facing value is organizing conversational workflows and project/non-project context switching in the UI.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面新增 Chat 与 Work 模式入口，并通过托管的 Chat 会话工作区来统一管理非项目对话，便于在对话和项目工作间切换。
summaries.en: This plugin adds Chat and Work mode navigation to the DeepSeek Harness web UI and keeps non-project conversations organized in a managed Chat workspace for easier switching and context handling.

capabilities: Registers Chat/Work mode segments in the host session mode system
Creates and pins a dedicated Chat workspace in the sidebar and conversation registry
Maintains chat/work mode behavior during navigation and New Session flows
Writes and reconciles workspace-related state in DeepSeek Harness session directories
Handles migration/removal logic for a legacy chat preset when safe
